sentences.text: Learned Advocate for Applicant submitted that, the Applicant and Respondent No.2 have settled the matter amicably and have executed 'Consent Terms' dated 18th April 2023.
That, in para No.4 of the Consent Terms, the Respondent No.2 has agreed to give her consent for quashment of the said crime.
The Respondent No.2 has also filed an Affidavit dated 18 th April 2023 duly affirmed before a Notary Public.
Her signature has been identified by Advocate Mr.Nitin S. Borkar.
In para No.6 thereof, the Respondent No.2 has given her 'no objection' for quashing the said CR No. 980 of 2022 registered with Mumbra Police Station, District Thane.
Learned Advocate appearing for Respondent No.2 conceded the fact of affirmation of Affidavit dated 18 th April 2023 and execution of Consent Terms dated 18 th April 2023 by the Respondent No.2.
He submitted that, the Respondent No.2 has no objection in quashing the said CR No. 980 of 2022.
5. In view of above, Application is allowed in terms of prayer Clause (a).

[ PRAKASH D. NAIK, J. ] [ A.S. GADKARI, J. ]
